column1: # Game profile of Super Mario 3D All-Stars (Switch, update v393216 = 1.1.4): program 0, the launcher, of one game of several programs. Plays on the Mac
# Nintendo's sead / agl / gsys with NintendoWare layouts on NVN, SDK 10.8.1; the opening and each tile's artwork are H.264 movies through the SDK's movie library (subsdk0)
# the menu wraps its clears in conditional rendering (SetRenderEnableConditional): without evaluating it every frame is black
# One game of four programs, as on the cartridge: this launcher starts the others with oe::ExecuteProgram. Each has its own profile folder; the host is built over all of them (game.py header_multi)
# and the NSP script packs them as one IPA, Mac app or Mac run command. Program 3, Super Mario Galaxy, is 32-bit ARM, which Apple silicon cannot run: it has no profile
# main sets a heap of at most the pool − 64 MB: a 3328 MB heap region
# the NPDM declares 0 MB of system resource: IsVirtualAddressMemoryEnabled is false, as on Horizon (Big Brain Academy: Brain vs. Brain sets a heap only then)
